integrity: The center-dimension theorem follows analytically from tangent-normal spanning. Independent scientific review and external certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real finite Lipschitz-free spaces with two equal parts of size at least two and strictly interior snowflake parameter 1<t<2; canonical zero-sum Euclidean realization. Finite numerical checks corroborate but do not establish the infinite result. Unindexed equivalent literature remains a risk.
title: Arithmetic resonances in the Euclidean inballs of snowflaked complete-bipartite transportation balls
